### A Eulogy for [Father's Name]

Good morning/afternoon everyone.

Thank you all for being here. I know this is a time of mixed emotions for many of us. For me, standing here today is a complex experience. I am here to say goodbye to a man who was my father, but I am also here to acknowledge the reality of the man he was.

My father, [Father's Name], passed away last week. As we gather to remember him, I want to speak about the truth of our relationship, because silence is not always the highest form of respect.
